metadata.title: Index for a mutation loop
metadata.abstract: Motivated by the 3d-3d correspondence, we introduce an index $\mathcal{I}_g^\phi$ for a mutation loop $\phi$ of a quiver and an integer $g \geq 0$. We prove its integrality $\mathcal{I}_g^\phi \in \mathbb{Z}$ under certain conditions, which extends the integrality conjecture of Gang--Kim--Yoon for $3$-manifolds to the broader framework of mutation loops in cluster algebras. Our index also has an interpretation as the genus-$g$ partition function of a $(1+1)$-dimensional TQFT. We provide explicit computations for mutation loops of period one. In particular, in the case of the generalized Kronecker quivers, we give an explicit formula expressing the generating function of the indices for all genera $g$ as a ratio of polynomials. Altogether, we provide a new insight to the interplay between the geometry of $3$-manifolds and cluster algebra.

analysis.workSummary: 为箭图的 mutation loop 和非负整数 genus 定义指标，证明在指定条件下它为整数；给出二维 TQFT 配分函数解释及周期一 mutation loop 的计算，并对广义 Kronecker 箭图给出全 genus 生成函数的有理表达式。
analysis.breakthrough: 将三维流形指标的整数性问题置入更广的簇代数框架。
analysis.limitations: 依据官方标题、摘要及作者评论的摘要级分析，尚未审读数学证明。整数性带有条件，摘要未列全；不能据此宣称任意箭图或任意 mutation loop 均已覆盖。 AI 披露以独立全文核查记录为准。
analysis.priorityReason: 按与几何研究的关联、结论范围和可迁移方法安排阅读；整数性带有条件，摘要未列全；不能据此宣称任意箭图或任意 mutation loop 均已覆盖。
